lines.t: Before empires roll, before doctrines harden, the Most High spoke and the way was won.
Yeah, I stood at the gate where two roads divide
One loud with promise, one quiet with life
The crowd moved fast, their hands held high
But truth stood still and met my eyes
It didn't offer silver or a throne
It asked for my heart, my will, my bones
Leave what you were, come walk and see
Set the living word calling me
Not written on stone alone
But carved in the heart when the proud let go
Not heroes or words, but walkers made new
A covenant lived, faithful and true
I follow the footsteps in the dust
Where truth stays sharp and pride tends to rust
And I'm my way, not the voice of man
I walked the path he walked back then
Through fire refined, through faith aligned
Breath of the most high filling my lungs
I won't turn back, I won't delay, I won't walk away
He touched the outcast, spoke straight to kings
Called out the lie, wrapped in hollow things
He honored the Torah, fulfilled it in light
Lived every word, not one denied
No mask, no blend with the world's applause
He stood unmoved by the threat of loss
Servant's hands, yet authority clear
The kingdom drawn near, right here
Repent means turn, not feel regret
Change direction, place your steps
Wide road packed but the soul runs dry
Narrow stays quiet but the truth stays alive
Commands ain't changed, they're life in motion
Written within, fueled by devotion
Not religion, not culture, not man-made flame
Set apart living, branded by name
Obedience ain't easy, it cuts through the night
Follow the way, stand up and fight
Dust on your feet, fire in your heart
Every small step is a brand new start
Turn from the wide, step into light
Every breath living, walk in his sight
No compromise, no half measures taken
Life's fully given when the king awakens
Strip me clean of borrowed names
Teach my feet your ancient ways
If it costs me all I've been
Let obedience be how I win
I follow the footsteps in the dust
Truth before comfort, obedience first
From dawn to dusk, from breath to grave
I choose the life the Father gave
No turning back, no divided way
The night of death is where I'll stay
Not tradition, not the world
Only truth lived in Yahushua
We'll be right back.
